plain: To make more powerful or important, often unfairly

webster.text: To make great or greater in power, rank or honor; to exalt; as, to aggrandize a family.

more.text: To enlarge, applied to things; as, to aggrandize our conceptions.

example.quote: Here then is a mutual connection & influence, that will perpetuate the President, and aggrandize both him & the Senate.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, September 6, 1787
